the impact loads related to the pancakes collapse are significantly larger than the total weight over the collapse story,and the maximum impact load is 7.9 times of the total collapse weight,while the maximum impact load in the previous studies is only 2.5 times of the total impact weight.

the impact loads of the pancake collapses of frame-shear walls are much higher than the total weight of the collapse story,therefore the impact loads of pancake collapses of real frame-shear wall buildings should be taken into consideration in their design.
